create_contact.description: Create ONE contact. The common case. TanStack DB optimistic mutations, mobile add-contact, MCP tools. Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Returns `{ data: { contact: {...} } }` with status 201. For bulk create, use `POST /v2/contacts/batch`.
create_contact.name: create_contact

parameters.description: Required. UUID per logical operation, reused on every retry. See `apps/rest-api/src/shared/idempotency.ts` for the full contract. Missing → 400 BadRequest; same key + different body → 409 Conflict.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

create_note.description: Create a note (a `timeline_items` row) optionally linked to contacts. Returns the created note in the canonical single-entity envelope.
create_note.name: create_note

parameters.description: Required. UUID per logical operation, reused on every retry. See `apps/rest-api/src/shared/idempotency.ts` for the full contract. Missing → 400 BadRequest; same key + different body → 409 Conflict.

audience.description: Workspace notes only: "shared" (every member, the default) or "private" (only the author). Only the author may change it. Ignored for Personal notes, which are always private.

is_origin.description: Marks the contact whose page the note was written on. Create only; at most one link may set it. Ignored on update.

create_reminder.description: Create a new reminder for the authenticated user. With `X-Dex-Workspace`, `tag_ids` (up to 100 workspace tag ids; duplicates are dropped) tags the reminder; a tag outside the workspace is 400 `invalid_reference` and creates nothing. Reminder tags are workspace-only: a Personal request with `tag_ids` is 400 `workspace_context_required`. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. see Idempotency below. Returns `{ data: { reminder: {...} } }` with status 201.
create_reminder.name: create_reminder

parameters.description: Required. UUID per logical operation, reused on every retry. See `apps/rest-api/src/shared/idempotency.ts` for the full contract. Missing → 400 BadRequest; same key + different body → 409 Conflict.
parameters.name: idempotency_key

get_company.name: get_company

Returns the canonical /v2 envelope `{ data: { user } }`. With any API key the response leaves out the account's stored credentials (`email_key`, `zapier_key`, saved sync sessions), and a workspace-bound key's `include` is ignored: its response carries no related records.

get_reminder.description: Retrieve a single reminder by its unique ID. Returns the canonical /v2 envelope `{ data: { reminder } }`. see Migration notes below. With `X-Dex-Workspace`, `include[tags]` or `include[reminders_tags]` (or the same keys in `select`) adds `reminders_tags`: the reminder's workspace tags as `{ tag_id, tags: { id, name } }`, by name. Reminder tags are workspace-only: a Personal request asking for them gets `reminders_tags: []`.

list_contact_notes.name: list_contact_notes

list_contacts.description: Retrieve contacts for the authenticated user with cursor pagination, filtering (`where`), sorting (`orderBy`), and field selection (`include` / `select`). Returns `{ data: { contacts: [...], pagination: { nextCursor, count } } }`.

list_groups.description: List all of the authenticated user's groups. Returns the canonical list envelope: `{ data: { groups: [...] } }`. Supports `?orderBy[name]=asc|desc` and `?orderBy[number_of_contacts]=asc|desc`, plus `?where[has_parent]=true` / `?where[has_subgroups]=true` for sidebar tree navigation.
list_groups.name: list_groups

list_reminders.description: Retrieve all reminders for the authenticated user. Supports filtering, sorting, and cursor pagination. list_reminders.name: list_reminders

list_tags.description: List the authenticated user's tags with cursor pagination (`?take=` / `?cursor=`). Pass `?include[contacts_count]=true` to attach `_count.tags_contacts` per tag; sort with `?orderBy[name]=asc|desc` or `?orderBy[contacts_count]=asc|desc`. Returns `{ data: { tags: [...], pagination: { nextCursor } } }`.

search_contacts.description: Name-only typeahead. search_contacts.name: search_contacts
